description.value:
Your body has an integrated weapon mount that can hold a one-handed weapon. You can install or uninstall a weapon into this weapon mount using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Install Upgrade] activity. You're always wielding a weapon installed in your weapon mount. An installed weapon can't be disarmed, dropped, or stolen.

Choose one common commercial simple weapon you can install on your weapon mount. You begin with this weapon already installed in your weapon mount. You don't need to pay the credits to purchase this starting weapon, but you do need to purchase any ammo it requires.

Special If you have the combatant SRO heritage, you can instead install a one-handed martial weapon or a two-handed weapon in your weapon mount.
